---
title: "Lightbox: true"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/pandoc-figure.qmd:
# `lightbox: true` is automatic mode; a captioned figure is wrapped and its
# caption becomes the link title.
lightbox: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'script[src$="glightbox/glightbox.min.js"]'
          - 'div.quarto-figure figure a.lightbox[title="A Lovely Image"] > img'
        - []
---
